name: lowdown
author: Kristaps Dzonsons
description: lowdown shows Markdown files formatted in the Terminal and converts them to HTML, man pages, LaTeX or OpenDocument. Type lowdown -tterm README.md.
usage: lowdown -tterm FILE.md (formatted in the Terminal) | -thtml (HTML) | -tman | -tlatex | -tfodt (LibreOffice) [-s complete document] [-o OUT]. Reads stdin without FILE.

descriptions.en: lowdown shows Markdown files formatted in the Terminal and converts them to HTML, man pages, LaTeX or OpenDocument. Type lowdown -tterm README.md.
descriptions.it: lowdown mostra i file Markdown formattati nel Terminale e li converte in HTML, pagine man, LaTeX o OpenDocument. Scrivi lowdown -tterm LEGGIMI.md.

does.en: Markdown converter: to formatted Terminal text, HTML page, man, LaTeX or LibreOffice .fodt. Run: lowdown -thtml -s IN.md -o OUT.html | lowdown -tterm IN.md
does.it: Convertitore Markdown: testo formattato nel Terminale, pagina HTML, man, LaTeX o .fodt per LibreOffice. Uso: lowdown -thtml -s IN.md -o OUT.html | lowdown -tterm IN.md
